text: Determine the current Codex hook discovery, launch, worktree, configuration, authentication, and supported-action behavior that makes project-local interception non-durable or identifies a stronger host boundary.
acceptance_intent: Name the authoritative launch boundary, exact hook input/output contract, worktree behavior, action coverage, and credential limitation without speculation.

planner_obligations.description: Carry the grounded worktree-safe interception boundary, supported surfaces, fail-closed preflight, and authentication constraint into planning.

text: The workflow launcher must establish worktree-independent pre-action interception before a governed Codex session begins, prove the live hook before work, and fail closed when enforcement or authorized authentication is unavailable.
acceptance_intent: An ordinary repository and a Git worktree both prove interception before mutation; unavailable hook support or authentication produces a visible pre-launch rejection.

planner_obligations.description: Plan ordinary-repository, worktree, unsupported-action, hook-challenge, resume, and authentication-boundary verification.

text: Determine whether the current OwnerSpec, registry, prevention event contract, controller, and metrics persist an authoritative pre-dispatch recurring-action eligibility fact and identify the exact absent producer/consumer fields.
acceptance_intent: Prove the present denominator inputs or their absence across registry production, controller persistence, and metric aggregation.

planner_obligations.description: Carry the exact authoritative recurrence metadata, eligibility event, producer timing, immutable inputs, and denominator consumer into planning.

text: Every governed intent must persist a controller-derived recurring-action eligibility decision from a frozen registry revision before dispatch so the registered-use denominator is reproducible and cannot be reclassified after outcome.
acceptance_intent: The metric query derives numerator and denominator only from durable events and a content-addressed registry snapshot, including explicit ineligible reason codes.

planner_obligations.description: Plan tamper, outcome-reclassification, missing-registry, ineligible-intent, and 95-percent threshold tests.

text: Inventory all 25 owner rows and determine, from authoritative source implementations, which concrete parameter schema, canonical argv or typed call, action class, full-unit budget, durable effect identity, reconciliation rule, terminal schema, recurrence eligibility, and availability facts are materialized versus only named or described in prose.
acceptance_intent: Return an exact 25-row coverage map whose positive facts cite authoritative implementation evidence and whose unavailable facts fail closed rather than being invented.

planner_obligations.description: Carry a finite materialized 25-owner contract input, evidence provenance, and explicit unavailable-owner state into planning.

text: Each of the 25 registered owner IDs must resolve to a content-addressed executable typed contract or an explicit fail-closed unavailable state; runtime code must not infer executable behavior from prose or identifier names.
acceptance_intent: Registry initialization validates every materialized contract and source hash; dispatch/reconcile/terminal behavior is deterministic; missing evidence prevents owner registration.

planner_obligations.description: Plan schema validation, all-25 coverage, source-hash drift, no-prose-inference, unavailable-owner, dispatch, crash/reconcile, and terminal tests.
